description: List the workspace's whole library of standing rules (design system, tone of voice, brand, compliance, accessibility, shared knowledge), with how many projects hold each one. Read this before writing a rule: attaching one that already exists with `set_project_guideline` beats typing a second copy of it.

include_disabled.description: Include rules that are switched off in the library. Defaults to true; pass false to see only rules in force.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_workspace_guidelines

apply_to_design_reviews.description: Whether every design review in the workspace is held to this rule.

attached_project_count.description: How many projects have this rule attached.

enabled.description: The library switch: false retires the rule everywhere.

id.description: Library guideline UUID, the guideline_id other tools take.

source.description: Where the rule came from: manual, generated or imported.

title: List workspace guidelines
